title: Bar — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Bar: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Bar has a population of 42,000. A coastal town in southern Montenegro on the Adriatic Sea, known for its port, the Old Town of Stari Bar, and the long sandy beach of Šušanj. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Reported crime rates are relatively low.

Last updated: November 07, 2026
